items.title: SCP Halloween Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
The best way to celebrate Halloween! Get your favorite costume out and let the holiday begin. Role-play as cool teens ready to give everyone a big fright. Gear up with fabulous SCP fashion designs just in time for your Halloween party.

1 free scary skin included!

items.title: SCP Halloween Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
What a way to celebrate Halloween! Combine your favorite costumed mobs with the paranormal. Role-play as a clown creeper, drowned pirate, or skeleton soldier to really give everyone a fright. Gear up as an unnatural creature and see if anyone can contain you!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Halloween Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
There’s probably not a better night in the year to be a cybercriminal! Choose from 12 Halloween costume skins with hacker face masks. Role-play as a mischievous computer expert trying to cause a little tech trouble. Look totally innocent in a disguise that fits right into the spooky holiday!

1 free skin included!

items.title: TNT Halloween
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Not just jack-o-lanterns and pumpkins, celebrate Halloween in an explosive way. Choose from 12 different dynamite skins that combine TNT and cool costumes. Role-play in your favorite dangerous block decorated with skeletons and ghosts. It’s a spooky good time!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Bodybuilders
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Wow! Looks like you have been working out hard at the gym! Flex your muscles and role-play as you lift weights and build your body. Choose from 8 strong and sturdy skins that are in fine form. Be sure to strike a proper pose and show off the results of all your efforts.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Techno Anime Demons
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Have a devil of a time in these sassy skins! Choose from 12 different dashing demon options in awesome techno color combinations. Role-play as a stylish evil spirit, complete with little horns and big anime eyes. You’re ready for mischief!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cute Cats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Arch your back and let out a meow! Choose from cute cat and kitten skins to perch up high and pounce when you’re ready. Make a colony with friends and role-play as the most fabulous felines around.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Floral Mobs
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Spring may be gone, but who's to say you can't enjoy some flowers?

*12 floral mobs
*2 skins free

items.title: Cocky Mobs
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Whoa, seems like you are on the wrong server, buddy.
It seems like some of the mobs are tired of being beaten over and over and decided to bully players in a different way… This skin pack brings a street wanderer's style for beloved mobs.

+ Vanilla
+ Monsters
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Emo Masks Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Emo's are back in a town! This skin pack brings you a team of masked and fashionable teens. Grab them all and change your outfits whenever you want, play with friends and enjoy the game with new character looks.

+ Teen fashion
+ Emo
+ 1 free skin
+ By In mine

items.title: Sirenhead Night Survival
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
This skin pack brings a fresh look for famous siren head monsters. Will you hunt down your friends and other players as the monster or will run and hide as a survivor?

+ Monsters
+ Scary
+ Creepy
+ Horrors
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Winter Fashion
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Bundle up for the holidays! These skins will help you stay warm on all of your winter adventures!
- 10 unique skins
- by SleepyK0

items.title: BFF Slumber Party
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
It's a sleepover! Break out the popcorn and have a pillow fight! These skins are perfect for a night in with your friends!
- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: May Flowers
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Frolic in the flowers with your friends, and celebrate spring with these colorful floral skins!
- 10 unique skins
- by SleepyK0

items.title: Forest Tea Party
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Dress up for a special forest outing with your friends! Explore the woods dressed as your favorite animal with these skins!
- 10 unique skins
- by Kyuuri

items.title: Monsters
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Trick or treat? There's no way you can fail with these great monster costumes!
Whether you choose to be a pumpkin, a ghost or a scary clown, you will surely succeed!

+ 12 monster costumes you're able to try on, in order to unleash the spooky spirit!
+ Surprise your friends with these scary monsters!

items.title: Scary Creatures
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
If you're a fan of Halloween, you will surely love these skins as well.
Ghosts, witches, skeletons... We have them all here, waiting for you!

+ 12 scary creatures you're able to try out.
+ Enjoy the Halloween vibes and surprise your friends with all these skins!

items.title: Ghosts
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Booooo, it's time to turn into a scary ghost teen and haunt everyone!

+ 12 skins you're able to equip!
+ Experience the life of a true ghost and enjoy the undead experience!

items.title: Werewolf vs Vampire
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Vampires or werewolves, who will emerge victorious?
Choose your side and bring the Halloween spirit back to life.

+ 6 vampires and 6 werewolves clashing in the ultimate Halloween battle!
+ Strike fear into all your enemies!

items.title: Zombies Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
The apocalypse is here, quicker than anyone could've ever imagined..
It's time to choose your side and decide who emerges victorious!

+ 6 teens and 6 zombies come face to face, taking on each other in the ultimate battle.
+ Turn into a zombie and hunt the humans or decide to stay as a teen and watch your back.

items.title: Advanced K-Pop
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Join these fellow friends in their next tour on boredom city, the arena will be full!
Bring joy to the town and your talent to the stage, help the k-pop stars prepare the best show ever.

+ 11 K-Pop singers!
+ 1 FREE skin!
+ By Senior Studios & Lune!

items.title: Mobs of the Month - October
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These mobs are ready for the season of spooks! Dressed in your favorite trick-or-treat classics, a mummy creeper, pumpkin sheep, scarecrow slime, ghost zombie and more! Choose from 14 Halloween-themed mob skins!

items.title: Odyssey Builder 2: Revenant
items.creator: Aurafall Studios
items.description:
Survival ready and creative mode friendly. Odyssey Builder 2: Revenant expands upon the first Odyssey Builder in a multitude of ways! Explore, conquer, and create on an expansive custom terrain map with friends, or brave it alone. A new world awaits!
Includes:
-32x texture pack
-4k x 4k custom map with world borders
-Custom mobs and items
-Quests

By Aurafall Studios

items.title: Nether Village
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: The nether may be scaring, but on this village in the edge between the overworld and the lava dimension you will discover all its secrets and explore the nether in a giant portal!
